description: Printed PETG step-up for two 125B pedals on their Type B1 plates. The Step Up's architecture scaled to two cells: a front leg, a sloped deck, a rear leg, over a 3 mm base plate that carries the retainer clips. The deck is slotted so a B1 plate drops on it.

datum.origin: centre of the base footprint, on the board-facing face
datum.x_axis: along the 180 mm length, the direction the two 125B plates sit side by side
datum.y_axis: across the depth, +Y toward the high edge of the deck
datum.z_axis: away from the board, toward the pedals

envelope.height_note: the Step Up's own 25.01 is a level deck; a sloped deck has to be taller to hold the same headroom at its low edge, so the height comes from the height block below

height.note: the low edge stands base 3.0 + clearance 3.0 + the retainer's 15.89 loop drop; the 9 deg slope then lifts the high edge by 172 x tan(9)

base.note: behaves like a 3 mm QuickMount plate: integral clips hang below it and its top face is the floor of the body

top.sheet_note: 4.0 rather than the board's 3.0 so the retainer's 4.0 ledge sits flush under the sheet with no foam pad; slot, rib and pitch are the board's

slot_field.note: measured in the deck's own plane, so a slot is a true 18 wide square to the deck; its plan width is 18 x cos(9)

top.layout_note: the landing ribs sit at the B1 plate's clip centres, 47.5 either side of centre; plate centres at x = -45 and +45 leave 18 mm between the two 72 mm plates and 9 mm to each end

body.note: ribs are clipped by the sloped body prism, so each one stops on the deck's underside at its own height; the retainer keep-outs are cut from the finished part

clips.note: 102.0 apart, which is 3 x the board's 34.0 pitch, so both clips land on ribs. The blade points outboard, so the closed window frees it while the post stays fused to the plate

board.note: 18 mm slot + 16 mm rib; the Cinque drawing prints it, the retainer config's 33.43 pair pitch is a different board and is not used here

target.clears: one row of Boss compact pedals

fabrication.print_orientation: base plate on the bed, the sloped deck rising last; the clips overhang and want supports
fabrication.supports: under the two clip loops only
fabrication.note: printing base-down keeps the clip mouths open with no bridging; the deck's slots print as short horizontal bridges

envelope.source: StepUp-2: 180.00 cells over 142.50 depth; depth widened to 172.0 to carry the 73.5 mm slot edge either side of centre

height.source: derived from the retainer section's 15.89 loop drop in ../commons/cfg/retainer.json plus a 3.0 base and 3.0 clearance; lands within 0.3 of PedalRiser-L's printed 49

clip_placement.source: ../commons/cfg/retainer.json section; positions chosen 3 x 34.0 apart so both clips sit on ribs

target.source: ../enclosure_125b/cfg/enclosure_125b.json: B1 is 72 x 125.5 with clips 95.0 apart

open_questions: The 9 deg deck is a starting point, not a measurement: StepUp-2's own top is level, so this is the PedalRiser wedge applied to the Step Up plan. Set deck_slope_deg to 0 for a level deck.

B1's own clips are 95.0 apart, which is not a multiple of 34.0, so on the real board the pair cannot both sit on ribs; this riser sidesteps that on its own underside but inherits it from the pedal plate above.
The 4.0 mm deck makes the drop-in grip flush, but it is 1 mm thicker than the board; keep a 1 mm pad on the board side of the plate if the same pedal also has to sit on the board.
